CREATE TABLE "public"."obra_datos_generales" (
  "contacto_cliente_correo" character varying(150),
  "contacto_cliente_nombre" character varying(150),
  "contacto_cliente_telefono" character varying(50),
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "departamento" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Lima',
  "direccion" character varying(1000),
  "distrito" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Lima',
  "expediente_codigo" character varying(100),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_centro_costo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "latitud" numeric,
  "longitud" numeric,
  "personal_activo_promedio" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  "provincia" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Lima',
  "semanas_totales" int4 DEFAULT 6,
  "turno_trabajo" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'Diurno',
  "ubigeo_cod" character varying(10),
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."obra_documentos_actas" (
  "archivo_url" character varying(1000),
  "categoria" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "estado" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'Validado',
  "fecha_emision" date,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_centro_costo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nro_registro" character varying(100),
  "subtitulo" character varying(1000),
  "titulo" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "vigencia_texto" character varying(100),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."obra_incidencias_rfi" (
  "accion_solicitada_o_ejecutada" character varying(1000),
  "codigo_incidencia" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(1000) NOT NULL,
  "estado" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'PENDIENTE',
  "fecha_reporte" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "fecha_resolucion" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_centro_costo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "plazo_resolucion" character varying(100),
  "prioridad" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'MEDIA',
  "responsable" character varying(150),
  "titulo" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."obra_planos" (
  "archivo_url" character varying(1000),
  "codigo_plano" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "disciplina" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "emitido_por" character varying(150),
  "es_vigente" bool DEFAULT true,
  "estado_aprobacion" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'Aprobado Obra',
  "fecha_vobo" date,
  "formato_peso" character varying(50),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_centro_costo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id_plano_anterior" int4,
  "nombre_plano" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "version" character varying(20) DEFAULT 'v1.0',
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."obra_residentes" (
  "cip_cap" character varying(50),
  "correo" character varying(150),
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()),
  "especialidad" character varying(150),
  "estado_planta" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'En Planta',
  "foto_url" character varying(1000),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_anexo" int4,
  "id_centro_costo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nombre_completo" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "orden" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  "rol_obra" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "telefono" character varying(50),
  "turno" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'Lun - Sáb 07:00 - 18:00',
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."obra_semanas_cronograma" (
  "descripcion_actividades" character varying(1000),
  "estado" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'Programado',
  "etiqueta_semana" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "fase_principal" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "fecha_fin" date NOT NULL,
  "fecha_inicio" date NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "id_centro_costo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "numero_semana" int4 NOT NULL,
  "orden" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  "porcentaje_meta" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric,
  "porcentaje_real" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric,
  "responsable_nombre" character varying(150),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ppto_Plantillas" (
  "Activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "Descripcion" character varying(500),
  "FechaCreacion" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "IdPlantilla" character varying(255),
  "Nombre" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ppto_Plantillas_Categorias" (
  "CostoReferencial" numeric,
  "IdPlantillaFase" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "IdpptoFaseCategoria" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ppto_Plantillas_Fases" (
  "IdPlantilla" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "IdPlantillaFase" character varying(255),
  "IdpptoFase" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "Orden" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
